CweFindings.Name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
CweFindings.Description: The product allows the upload or transfer of dangerous file types that are automatically processed within its environment.
CweFindings.Explanation: `PhotoService.UploadPhotoAsync` trusts the client-provided `ContentType` for the allowlist check (PhotoAlbum/Services/PhotoService.cs:81-88). If ImageSharp cannot decode the content, the exception is logged but execution continues (lines 125-138), after which the bytes are saved to disk (lines 140-145). Thus a file with a permitted declared MIME type but arbitrary/dangerous content can be stored and later served.
